selection: original 80 families retained, answers repaired before model scoring
split_rule: Porter stems of ambiguous words and candidates in connected components, seed 1910, greedy size balance
cue_primary: generated meaning-correct answer; cued choice is a hint-use diagnostic
context_factor: semantic specification: broad domain versus detailed meaning, equal word counts via neutral padding in low context
context_note: not a pure control manipulation; dominance and lesion position supply the planned control contrasts

review.basis: source checking and two rounds of semantic review before any new-material model scores
